every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited
record cards. Repeated records and multiple cards from one context are not
independent evidence. Return exactly one valid JSON object and do not reveal

Glimepiride is reported as almost completely bioavailable (C03), close to 100% bioavailable in humans (C16), confirmed as complete by absolute AUDC/urinary recovery versus IV (C19), and listed as 100% bioavailable (C24).
These direct human absolute-bioavailability measurements are far above the F >= 20% threshold and provide affirmative, transferable evidence for a high prediction.

No direct solubility or first-pass metabolism data for the query are provided; the physicochemical prior is mixed/unclear but not negative.
